scripts.hook: Your intellectual fly is open when you use an LLM to write your emails. Here is why.
scripts.full_script:
This script is designed to trigger a "wait, am I doing this wrong?" moment, which is the gold standard for viral engagement in the AI/productivity niche.

---

## HOOK VARIATIONS
1. **[CURIOSITY]**: "Your intellectual fly is open every time you use ChatGPT to write your emails. Here’s why."
2. **[FEAR/LOSS AVERSION]**: "Stop letting AI write your emails. You’re accidentally signaling that you’re lazy, not efficient."
3. **[ASPIRATION]**: "Want to sound smarter in your emails? Stop using AI the way 99% of people do."

---

## FULL SCRIPT
**[0-3s]**: [Close up of you looking directly at the camera, serious expression] "Your intellectual fly is open every time you use ChatGPT to write your emails. Here is why."

**[3-10s]**: [Cut to you sitting at your laptop, typing, then shaking your head] "We all use LLMs to draft replies to save time. But there’s a new trend in high-level networking: people are *identifying* AI-written emails instantly."

**[10-25s]**: [Quick cuts of you pointing at screen text overlays] "It’s not just the 'delve' or 'comprehensive' vocabulary. It’s the lack of 'jaggedness.' Human writing has rhythm, pauses, and personal biases. AI writing is too smooth, too polite, and too predictable. When you send a polished, generic AI email, you aren't showing efficiency—you’re showing that you didn't care enough to engage."

**[25-40s]**: [Screen recording of a generic email vs. a human-edited one] "The top 1% aren't stopping the use of AI; they’re using it as a ghostwriter, not a replacement. Use the AI to brainstorm or structure, but rewrite the core argument in your own voice. The difference in response rate? Massive."

**[38-45s]**: [Back to camera] "If you want my exact prompt for 'humanizing' AI drafts so nobody catches you, comment 'HUMAN' below and I’ll DM it to you."

---

## CAPTION
Your intellectual fly is open every time you use ChatGPT to write your emails. 🤐

We’re all using AI to save time, but there’s a massive problem: people are getting *really* good at spotting AI-written emails. It’s not just the vocabulary; it’s the lack of rhythm, the excessive politeness, and the lack of "jaggedness" that makes human writing unique.

When you send a generic, AI-polished email, you aren't signaling that you're an AI-power user. You're signaling that you didn't care enough to engage with the person on the other side.

The fix? Don't use AI as a replacement. Use it as a ghostwriter, then inject your own voice back in.

Want the prompt I use to "humanize" my AI drafts so they don't sound like a robot wrote them?

Comment 'HUMAN' and I’ll DM it to you for free. 🚀

#AI #ChatGPT #ProductivityHacks #Entrepreneurship #GarvitIRL #TechTips #Networking

---

1. **The "Value" Hook**: "Comment 'HUMAN' and I’ll DM you my exact prompt to make your AI drafts sound like YOU."
2. **The "Direct" Hook**: "Drop 'HUMAN' in the comments and I’ll send you my secret prompt to avoid the 'AI-filter' in your emails."
